methodologyNote: Measured via search host referrals in tracked traffic.
metricLabel: market share of tracked page views / usage
aiSummary: In October 2026, Google google.com led search engine hosts (mobile) in India at 98.73% (market share of tracked page views / usage). Google google.co.in ranked second at 0.5%, followed by DuckDuckGo duckduckgo.com at 0.35%.

faqs.question: Which item leads search engine hosts (mobile) in India?
faqs.answer: Google google.com leads at 98.73% in October 2026 (market share of tracked page views / usage). Source: https://gs.statcounter.com/search-engine-host-market-share/mobile/india.

faqs.question: What does the market share of tracked page views / usage metric mean?
faqs.answer: Figures are market share of tracked page views / usage from the cited source for October 2026. They are not invented estimates.

faqs.question: What are the top three for search engine hosts (mobile) in India?
faqs.answer: Google google.com (98.73%), Google google.co.in (0.5%), DuckDuckGo duckduckgo.com (0.35%) in October 2026.
